source_notes: Discount availability and stacking rules vary by carrier and state. Each item lists the carriers that explicitly advertise it as of the as_of date — the agent should treat this list as a checklist to ASK each carrier about, not a guarantee.

discounts.name: Multi-policy (auto + home/condo/renters)
discounts.qualifies_if: Same household has another policy with the same carrier or affiliated group.

discounts.name: Multi-vehicle
discounts.qualifies_if: Two or more vehicles on the same policy.

discounts.name: Multi-driver / household
discounts.qualifies_if: Spouse or family member added.

discounts.name: Safe-driver / good-driver
discounts.qualifies_if: Typically 3-5 years with no at-fault accidents or major violations.

discounts.name: Telematics / usage-based
discounts.qualifies_if: Opt into the carrier's app/device for 30-180 days.
warnings: Snapshot, Drivewise, and DriveEasy can RAISE your rate at renewal if your driving scores poorly. SafePilot, SmartRide, and Drive Safe & Save are discount-only (no penalty) at most carriers — confirm in writing.

discounts.name: Pay-per-mile
discounts.qualifies_if: Annual mileage below ~8,000.

discounts.name: Defensive-driving course completion
discounts.qualifies_if: Approved state-recognized course; some states limit to drivers 50/55+.

discounts.name: Accident-free renewal
discounts.qualifies_if: Sustained over 3+ policy renewals.

discounts.name: Anti-theft device
discounts.qualifies_if: Factory or aftermarket immobilizer, alarm, GPS tracker.

discounts.name: Anti-lock brakes
discounts.qualifies_if: Factory ABS.

discounts.name: Airbags / passive restraint
discounts.qualifies_if: Factory airbags.

discounts.name: ADAS / collision avoidance
discounts.qualifies_if: Factory AEB, lane keep, blind-spot.

discounts.name: New-vehicle discount
discounts.qualifies_if: Vehicle is current-model-year or 1-2 years old.

discounts.name: Electric / hybrid vehicle
discounts.qualifies_if: EV or hybrid drivetrain.

discounts.name: VIN etching / glass etching
discounts.qualifies_if: VIN etched on windows.

discounts.name: Good student
discounts.qualifies_if: Full-time student under 25 with B average / 3.0 GPA / dean's list.

discounts.name: Student-away-at-school
discounts.qualifies_if: Student listed on policy but lives 100+ miles from the garaging address without a car.

discounts.name: Driver-training course
discounts.qualifies_if: Newly licensed driver completed an approved course.

discounts.name: Senior 50+ / mature-driver
discounts.qualifies_if: Driver 50/55+, often paired with defensive-driving course.

discounts.name: Married
discounts.qualifies_if: Married driver listed.

discounts.name: Homeowner (without bundling)
discounts.qualifies_if: Own a home, even if home policy is elsewhere.

discounts.name: Military / veteran / active-duty
discounts.qualifies_if: Verifiable military service.

discounts.name: Federal employee
discounts.qualifies_if: Current US federal employee.

discounts.name: Alumni / professional association
discounts.qualifies_if: Member of a participating university alumni group or professional association (engineers, teachers, nurses, etc.).

discounts.name: Employer / group rate
discounts.qualifies_if: Employer offers an affinity program with the carrier.

discounts.name: Teacher / first responder
discounts.qualifies_if: Currently employed as teacher, police, fire, EMT, nurse.

discounts.name: Paid-in-full
discounts.qualifies_if: Pay 6- or 12-month premium upfront.

discounts.name: Paperless / e-documents
discounts.qualifies_if: Opt into electronic delivery.

discounts.name: Auto-pay / EFT
discounts.qualifies_if: Bank-draft or recurring card.

discounts.name: Online quote / online buy
discounts.qualifies_if: Started or bought policy online.

discounts.name: Early-shopper / advance-quote
discounts.qualifies_if: Quote 7+ days before current policy expires (proves continuous coverage and shopping behavior).

discounts.name: Continuous coverage / prior-insurance
discounts.qualifies_if: No lapse in coverage for 6/12+ months.

discounts.name: Loyalty / longevity
discounts.qualifies_if: 3+ years with carrier or as a household.

always_ask_questions: List every discount currently applied to my quote, by name, with the percent.
List every discount I might qualify for that is NOT currently applied.
Is the telematics discount one-time, recurring at renewal, or at-risk of becoming a surcharge?
Is accident forgiveness included on this quote, earned over time, or paid as a rider?
Will the renewal premium assume the same discounts? Which discounts drop off?
What is the new-customer / new-business discount on this quote, and when does it expire?
Are you using a credit-based insurance score for my rate? Which tier am I in?
Is rental-reimbursement and roadside included or a rider?
Will adding gap coverage / OEM-parts / new-car-replacement change my rate?
